title: Think Global, Act Local: Bayesian Causal Discovery with Language Models in Sequential Data

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the over-optimism, hallucinations, and inconsistency of Language Models in predicting causal relationships by comparing LM-generated graphs against ground-truth causal structures using metrics like Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), Precision, and Recall.

Evaluating the performance of causal discovery algorithms on sequential, batch-wise observational data to assess how restricted data access and local sampling variations distort the learned causal structures.
